Subject: Revised duty roster
Dear all, the revised duty roster for December is attached. Kindly check your slots and inform the adjutant office of any clash by Friday. Regards, Capt. Mehra
Bhai kal shaam 6 baje mess mein dinner hai, CO saab bhi aa rahe hain. Uniform casual chalega.
Your ECHS card renewal has been processed. You can collect the card from the polyclinic reception between 0930 and 1300 hrs.
Hi papa, reached hostel safely. Exams start Monday, will call after the first paper.
IT Cell advisory: we have noticed fake SPARSH websites circulating. Always use https://sparsh.defencepension.gov.in and never share your OTP with anyone.
Reminder: password for the unit LAN must be changed every 90 days. Use the intranet self-service page or contact the signals JCO.
Congratulations on your promotion sir! The whole section is proud of you. Party is due!
Canteen will remain closed on Tuesday for annual stock taking. Inconvenience regretted.
Please find attached the minutes of yesterday's welfare meeting. Action points are highlighted in yellow.
The convoy briefing for the exercise will be held in the conference hall at 0800 hrs. All drivers to attend with their documents.
Mummy ne bola hai Diwali pe ghar aana zaroor, tickets abhi book kar lo warna mil nahi payenge.
Your Amazon order #402-118 has been shipped and will arrive by Thursday.
Dear Sir, as discussed on call, I am sending the draft of the sports meet budget. Please let me know if any changes are needed.
Gentle reminder that the blood donation camp is on Saturday at the MH. Volunteers please register with Sub. Rawat.
Thanks for the help with the move last week. The kids love the new quarter!
Hey, I came across your profile and you look like a really interesting person. Would love to be friends!
Hi handsome, you have such a kind smile in your DP. Are you in the army? My cousin is also in defence. Can we chat sometime?

Good evening Captain, I am a nursing student from Pune and I really admire people who serve the nation. I would love to know more about your life and your posting. Will you share some pictures of you in uniform and tell me where you are stationed these days?
Baby I miss you so much. Send me a video call now na, and show me your room and the area around your camp, I want to feel close to you.
Sweetheart, you promised you would tell me which base you are moving to next month. I will even come visit you there. Also send that pic of you with your unit like you said.
Hello dear, my name is Ananya, I work for a defence magazine. You are very attractive and I want to interview you privately. Please share your unit details and a few photos.
Congratulations! Your mobile number has won Rs 25 lakh in the KBC lucky draw. Call 9876543210 to claim.
Dear customer, your bank KYC is pending. Kindly update at the nearest branch to avoid service interruption.
Get 70% off on all smartphones this Diwali! Visit www.megadeals-sale.shop now.
SPARSH ALERT: Your pension has been put on hold due to incomplete Aadhaar seeding. Verify within 24 hours at http://sparsh-pension-verify.online/login or your pension will be stopped.
Dear Veteran, your DA arrears of Rs 48,600 are pending. To release the amount, log in with your service number and the OTP sent to your mobile at www.pcda-arrears.info

Subject: Mandatory account re-validation
From: IT Helpdesk <helpdesk@army-mail-secure.com>
Dear officer, your email account will be deactivated today due to a security upgrade. Click here to re-enter your password and keep your account active: https://army-mail-secure.com/validate
Hi sir, this is Major Singh from MS branch. I am in a meeting and can't call. Urgently need your army ID and the OTP you just received to process your posting order. Please send quickly.
CSD canteen smart card update: your card will be blocked. Share card number, CVV and OTP with our executive on WhatsApp 8800123456 to continue.
Your ECHS medical reimbursement claim is approved. Download the claim form here to receive payment: echs-claims.site/form
Sir please install the new Hamraaz update from this link, the old version stops working from Monday: hamraaz-new.apk
Attached is the posting list for 2026. Please enable macros to view the full document. Posting_List_2026.docm
Bro check this video of our battalion parade, it is hilarious! parade_video.mp4.exe
New Army Welfare app is now available outside Play Store. Download AWWA_Welfare.apk and allow installation from unknown sources to register your family.
Sir, the photo of the new duty roster is attached, open it on your office computer: roster_photo.jpg.scr
Download the latest version of our free PDF reader from our website to view the circular.
We have your private videos from the video call. Transfer Rs 50,000 by tonight or they will be sent to your commanding officer and your wife.
I know about your affair. Unless you send me the exercise schedule of your unit, everything goes public to your family and the regiment.
Sir, I recorded all our chats. If you don't cooperate and share what I asked, I will post them on Facebook and tag your unit.
It would be a shame if your senior officers found out about the photos you sent me. Let's keep this between us, all you need to do is send a little help.
You owe me after everything I did for you. Pay up this week or I'll tell people what really happened.
Hello sir, I am writing a research paper on India's border infrastructure. Could you tell me how many troops are deployed at your post and what equipment you have?
Just curious, when is your regiment moving to the new location? And how many vehicles are going in the convoy?
Bhai tumhari unit abhi kaunse sector mein hai? Aur radar wala setup kahan laga hai? Bas aise hi pooch raha hoon.
I am a defence journalist. Please share the frequencies used by your signals unit and the timings of your night patrols for my article.
Hey, what does a typical day look like for you at the base? What time do you guys usually go out on patrol?
Which station are you posted at these days? Is it near the border?
